name: enroll
title: Enroll an Existing Codebase
description: Adopt a pre-existing codebase through read-only understanding, documentation inventory, compliance review, provenance-tagged documentation rebuilding, and a terminal human approval report. The origin is never modified and no build phase runs.

phases.title: Understand the Existing Codebase
phases.purpose: Map the enrolled origin read-only from concrete repository evidence: project type, entry points, modules, dependencies, data flow, persistence, external integrations, tests, and build structure. Distinguish observed facts from uncertainty and cite repo-relative paths. Do not recommend or make edits.

phases.title: Inventory Their Documentation
phases.purpose: Inventory documentation already present in the enrolled origin. Record each relevant document by repo-relative path, what it explicitly claims, contradictions or stale areas, and which house documentation slots it can support. Their documents are evidence inputs only and must never be edited or treated as automatically correct.

phases.title: Compliance Check
phases.purpose: Check the enrolled origin against the applicable curated knowledge rules. Every finding must name the rule area, a verdict, repo-relative evidence paths, and why the evidence supports that verdict. Use cannot-determine when evidence is insufficient and not-applicable for rule areas outside this project type; never coerce uncertainty into pass or fail.

phases.title: Rebuild House Documentation
phases.purpose: Rebuild project documentation in the orchestrator project's house format using only repository evidence, their cited documents, prior verified findings, and explicitly named research. Every factual paragraph must carry at least one of exactly four provenance tags: [VERIFIED: <repo-relative-path>], [FROM-THEIR-DOCS: <file>], [UNVERIFIED], or [RESEARCH: <source-url-or-name>]. Put uncertainty in the document instead of guessing. Write generated output only under this orchestrator project; never edit, move, or delete anything in the enrolled origin.

phases.title: Enrollment Report and Human Gate
phases.purpose: Produce the terminal enrollment report for a human: observed architecture, documentation rebuilt, compliance findings including cannot-determine items, provenance-lint gaps, unresolved risks, and an explicit recommendation on whether to promote. This phase never starts build work; the project must stop for human approval.
